name: Home Sleep Apnea Test
sourceName: Synthetic criteria modeled on MCG outpatient guidance. Not licensed MCG content.

versions.approvalRule: All 3 criteria must be met to be approval-ready. Anything else goes to a clinician.
versions.note: Home testing is the usual first test for adults with suspected uncomplicated OSA.

criteria.title: Clinical suspicion of obstructive sleep apnea
criteria.description: At least 1 OSA symptom (habitual snoring, witnessed apneas, or excessive daytime sleepiness) AND a provider assessment that OSA is suspected.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Documented symptom and the provider's assessment.

criteria.title: No condition that makes home testing inappropriate
criteria.description: No documented significant cardiopulmonary disease, neuromuscular disease, chronic opioid use, or suspected non-OSA sleep disorder.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Problem list and medication list reviewed by the provider.

criteria.title: Recent face-to-face evaluation
criteria.description: A face-to-face clinical evaluation by the ordering provider within the past 6 months.
criteria.evidenceRequired: Dated encounter note from the ordering provider.

changeLog.author: A. Chen, RN, Clinical Policy
changeLog.summary: Initial set for home sleep apnea testing.
